D.name: Pure Cube Trinity
D.intro: A five-sided corner sauna for one or two. Three walls of glass make it bright and open, while the corner shape tucks neatly onto a deck, patio or small yard with a base of about 5' × 5'.
specs: Two 38½" full-height glass panels and a 33½" full glass door on the corner
Premium grade western red cedar, clear or knotty, single-stave bevel
6 mm tempered panels; door in 10 mm bronze or 6 mm mirror glass
Fully enclosed with rounded front corners; L-shape available
240V, 30–50 amp depending on the heater; final hookup by a licensed electrician
6 kW electric, sized for this room

about.title: Big light, small footprint
about.lede: The Trinity fits a real Finnish-style sauna into a corner of your yard.
items: Two 38½" full-height glass panels flank a full glass door set on the angled corner, so the room is bright from every seat.
Its corner shape sits on a base of about 5' × 5', ideal for decks, patios, condo terraces and cottage docks.
Clear or knotty western red cedar inside and out, with fully enclosed two-tier benches and rounded front corners.
Choose mirrored glass, or add slatted cedar semi-privacy panels over the front windows.
